notes: Spine: gap (coin vs pouch stress state) -> hypothesis -> phase-field method -> pressure/modulus sweep -> simulated plating stimulus -> main branch: tip-compression MEC -> stockier shape -> densification -> CE gain (PRF, experimental F1); branch 1: mechanical driving force MEC -> slower plating (PRP); branch 2: root von Mises rise (PRP); tradeoff MEC (densification vs the two costs) and critical-pressure PRF (F5d) -> design guidance (1-5 MPa for wetted PP) -> conclusion. Control: zero-pressure branched dendrite n19 contrasts n7. Audits: o4 (CE with pressure also declines by cycle 21, qualifies n12), n22 (paper's scope limit), n23 (experimental pressure unstated). Panel citations dropped for F2b, F4a-d, F5b: OCR cue 'electrochemistry' on phase-field outputs (technique ATOM). Figure/text mismatches in image_note: F4c text 29.4->37.3% for 2->10 MPa vs plotted 28.5->38.1%; F3c 19.5 MPa max not reached in the colour map; F4b current minimum at 12 MPa. Not in graph: SI-only fields (Fig S3-S7, Table S1 beyond two facts), Videos S1-S2.
